question: 24 Litolff bars in 2/4 that the file marks red although every note in them was read with confidence. For each number, what is in the boxed bar, left to right (lengths only)?

answers.1: two half notes in a chord, with ties coming from before it
answers.2: half note with a tremolo slash
answers.3: whole rest (counts for the bar: correct)
answers.4: two voices -- top: four eighth notes, a natural in front of the third; bottom: eighth note, eighth rest, quarter rest
answers.5: two voices -- a quarter note with a natural in front of it [as said]; a whole rest underneath
answers.6: four eighth notes; the first by itself with a flag, the last three beamed; a natural in front of the second
answers.9: two quarter notes in a chord a third apart, then a quarter rest
answers.11: eighth rest, then three eighth notes (the rest runs into the beam)
answers.12: two voices -- half note above, whole rest below
answers.13: four eighth notes, beamed; first two slurred, last two staccato
answers.14: four eighth notes, all staccato; a flat in front of the last
answers.15: half note, with an arc coming from before it
answers.16: two quarter notes; a sharp in front of the first; an arc leaving the second
answers.17: eighth rest, then three eighth notes (what looks like a dot is an ink flaw)
answers.18: two half-note heads in a chord with a (thick) tremolo slash
answers.19: two quarter notes on one stem (a chord), then a quarter rest
answers.20: two half notes on one stem, with arcs to and from them
answers.21: half notes on a stem (a chord)
answers.22: two quarter notes on one stem (a chord), then a quarter rest
answers.23: eighth rest, then three eighth notes, each a two-note chord

note: answers are a faithful condensation of his dictation; 'Tau' = 'Tile', '4/8 notes' = four eighth notes, '2/4' = two quarter notes

a printed note missing.6: one of four eighths (the first, flagged, by our guess)
a printed note missing.19: the two-note chord (only its quarter rest is written)

two voices added end to end.12: counted 6 (whole rest taken at 4 quarters beside a half)
two voices added end to end.5: only the quarter is written; the whole rest of the other voice is not

compared_with_the_file.ours: Sorting is OURS, from Sean's readings against the manifest's file contents. 8 of the 24 bars turn on a hollow (half/whole) mark read as a quarter or lost; the trace agent's own categories disagree with Sean's reading on several bars (e.g. 6, 8, 15).
